In OsmAnd, open Menu → Plugins → PersonalHub and enable it. Then return here and choose Try again. PersonalHub uses only temporary map points.

Distance: straight-line distance from your current location. Total time: recorded time at each place. Last visit: most recent check-in. Visits: number of check-ins.\n\nThe current place stays first. Missing distances and places never visited stay last. Equal values keep a stable name order, so sorting equal or missing values may look unchanged. Tap the selected criterion again to reverse the order.
